I doubt it is compatible with what prysm and silver implemented. excerpts.author: lucassaldanhaconsensys
excerpts.content:
Let me try to put it the way things are in my head...

AFAIU, we have 3 or 4 parallel streams of work active atm:
1. Seacast over gossipsub, implementing execution payload broadcast, being tested on pq-devnet-0-seacast
2. Waggle + fast proof broadcast, implementation based on a lighthouse branch and this notes https://notes.ethereum.org/@kamilsa/rk_I4TMJme, being tested on pq-devnet-0-waggle
3. A prysm prototype of EIP-8334 using waggle, with no devnets or anything yet

There is maybe a 4th stream that is looking into seacast over waggle, but I haven't looked into this one yet.

My pq-devnet-0-waggle branch is all about prototyping number 2, basically what is here https://github.com/kamilsa/lighthouse/commit/88690e9320

Next week I will try to look at seacast etc to better understand the proposal.
